note: 这是 DSH 原生插件内部 Host/Browser 绑定合同；不是独立通用 Runtime Adapter，也不允许先建设第二套 Web 或产品级 Mock Runtime。

ToolRuntime.invoke.signature: invoke(tool_id: str, input: dict, context: ExecutionContext) -> ToolResult

WorkflowRuntime.command.signature: command(workflow_id: str, command: str, payload: dict, actor: ActorContext) -> WorkflowEvent

ProjectStateRepository.commit.restriction: Only system_service after T42 pass or authorized human confirmation.

GateService.decide.signature: decide(gate_id: str, snapshot_id: str, decision: GateDecision, actor: ActorContext) -> DecisionSnapshot

ReportRenderer.render.restriction: Artifacts are projections, never source of truth.

DSHModelTool.preplanning_get_context.restriction: Read-only controlled context slice; never full project dump by default.

DSHModelTool.preplanning_apply_commands.restriction: Proposal submission only; direct Project State write and Gate approval are forbidden.

dsh_native_binding.context_injection: agent.inject() or agent/pre-step, verified against pinned DSH version
dsh_native_binding.session_project_rule: Project is the business source of truth; DSH Session stores interaction/execution trail only.
